# Project Arthouse

> Project Arthouse is a marketing studio from India. It makes occasion websites for birthdays, weddings and celebrations, brand identities and business websites, and manages social media pages.

Last updated: 2026-10-08. Prices are listed in Indian rupees (INR) and US dollars (USD); each is a price in its own right, not a conversion. Occasion websites have fixed prices. Websites, branding and social media are quoted in writing after a conversation.

## Services

### [Occasion websites](https://www.projectarthouse.com/occasion-websites.html)

A personal website made for one person or one day. It opens from a private link on any phone, so you can send it like a gift or an invitation.

Includes:
- Birthday reveals: One-day, three-day and seven-day experiences with photos, letters and a final reveal.
- Wedding invitations: Couple names, your story, the programme and a private link to share.
- Grihapravesh and family invitations: Date, venue, timing and a family message for a housewarming, puja or gathering.
- Father's Day and Valentine's: Tributes and love notes, from a single page to an eight-day Valentine's Week.

Plans and prices:
- 1 Day Birthday: INR 799 or USD 39.99. A personal one-day birthday website with photos, wishes, a heartfelt note, and a soft reveal experience. Includes: 1 custom birthday page; Photos + birthday message; Mobile-friendly design; Soft reveal animation; Private shareable link.
- 3 Day Curated Reveal: INR 999 or USD 59.99. Three connected reveal moments that unfold like a tiny emotional journey, perfect when one page feels too small. Includes: 3 reveal chapters; Countdown-style flow; Photo + letter sections; Interactive final reveal; Private shareable link.
- 7 Day Unfolding Experience: INR 1299 or USD 69.99. A week-long digital experience with memories, clues, photos, notes, and a final emotional reveal. Includes: 7-day unlock flow; Daily memories + notes; Mini interaction option; Premium animations; Final cinematic reveal.
- Wedding Invitation: INR 899 or USD 49.99. A polished wedding invitation website with couple names, programme details, celebration notes, and a private shareable link. Includes: Digital wedding invite; Couple story section; Programme details; Mobile-friendly design; Private shareable link.
- Grihapravesh: INR 899 or USD 49.99. A graceful digital invitation for Grihapravesh, housewarming, puja, family gathering, or a new home celebration. Includes: Custom invitation page; Date, venue + timing; Family message section; Mobile-friendly design; Private shareable link.
- Father's Day: INR 899 or USD 49.99. A warm digital tribute for Dad with photos, messages, memories, lessons, and one beautiful thank-you reveal. Includes: Father's Day tribute page; Photos + heartfelt message; Hero moments section; Soft reveal animation; Private shareable link.
- Valentine's Day (1 Day): INR 799 or USD 39.99. A personal Valentine's Day website with photos, a love note, sweet memories, and a private reveal moment. Includes: 1 romantic reveal page; Photos + love message; Cute interactive flow; Mobile-friendly design; Private shareable link.
- Valentine's Week (8 Days): INR 1699 or USD 79.99. An 8-day Valentine's Week experience with daily reveals, memories, notes, romantic prompts, and a final surprise. Includes: 8-day unlock journey; Daily love notes; Photos + memories; Premium animations; Final romantic reveal.

### [Branding](https://www.projectarthouse.com/branding.html)

A name, a mark and a set of rules, so everything you put out looks like it came from the same place.

Includes:
- Naming: Names that are distinct, sayable and available.
- Logo and identity system: The mark, its variations and how they are used.
- Colour and typography: A palette and typefaces chosen for where the brand will live.
- Packaging and print: Boxes, labels, cards and the things people hold.
- Brand guidelines: A short, practical guide for anyone who touches the brand.

Pricing: no fixed price list. A brand is priced by what it needs: a logo alone, a full identity, packaging on top. Tell us where the brand stands today and we will reply with scope, timeline and a written quote.

### [Websites](https://www.projectarthouse.com/websites.html)

Full websites that load fast, read clearly and stay easy for you to update after launch.

Includes:
- Structure and copy: What pages you need and what each one has to say.
- Design: A look that fits the brand and works on a phone first.
- Build: Clean, fast pages, checked on real devices.
- Domain, hosting and launch: Set up, connected and switched on.
- Care after launch: Updates, fixes and small changes when you need them.

Pricing: no fixed price list. No two websites are the same, so there is no price list here. Tell us what you have in mind, even if it is one line, and we will reply with scope, timeline and a written quote.

### [Social media](https://www.projectarthouse.com/social-media.html)

Your Facebook, Instagram and YouTube pages planned, designed and posted for you, so the brand shows up every week looking like itself.

Includes:
- Facebook, Instagram and YouTube: Pages set up, kept tidy and posted to on a schedule.
- Social media management: A month planned ahead, with one person who knows the brand.
- Post design: Single posts, carousels and stories in your brand's look.
- Video design: Short videos and reels edited for each platform.

Pricing: no fixed price list. How many platforms, how many posts a month, how much video: that decides the price. Tell us what your pages look like today and we will reply with a plan and a written quote.

## How a project runs

1. Brief: Tell us what you need and when you need it. A short call or a few lines is enough to start.
2. Proposal: We reply with scope, timeline and cost in writing, before any work begins.
3. Make: We design, build and write. You see progress at agreed checkpoints and can steer it.
4. Hand over: You get the files, the links and the logins, with a short guide to using them.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Project Arthouse?

Project Arthouse is a marketing studio from India. It makes occasion websites for birthdays, weddings and celebrations, brand identities and business websites, and manages social media pages.

### What is an occasion website?

An occasion website is a small personal website made for one event or one person, such as a birthday reveal, a wedding invitation or a Grihapravesh invitation. It is shared as a private link and opens on any phone.

### How much does an occasion website cost?

Occasion websites have fixed prices, from ₹799 to ₹1,699, or $39.99 to $79.99 in US dollars: 1 Day Birthday ₹799 ($39.99), 3 Day Curated Reveal ₹999 ($59.99), 7 Day Unfolding Experience ₹1,299 ($69.99), Wedding Invitation ₹899 ($49.99), Grihapravesh ₹899 ($49.99), Father's Day ₹899 ($49.99), Valentine's Day (1 Day) ₹799 ($39.99) and Valentine's Week (8 Days) ₹1,699 ($79.99).

### How much do websites, branding and social media cost?

These are quoted after a conversation, because scope varies. Share your idea through the form, by WhatsApp or by email and we reply with scope, timeline and cost in writing.

### Can I hire Project Arthouse for only one service?

Yes. You can take one service or all four. Each comes from the same studio, so they fit together if you add more later.

### Do you work with clients outside India?

Yes. The studio is based in India and works online with clients anywhere.

### How do I start a project?

Pick a plan on the rate card, or send a brief through the form, by WhatsApp or by email. We reply in writing before any work begins.

### What goes on an occasion website?

Your photos, your messages and the story in the order you want it told. An invitation also carries the date, venue and programme. All of it sits behind one private link that opens on any phone.

### How is an occasion website delivered?

You receive a private link. Send it by WhatsApp, text or email and it opens in the browser. Nobody has to install an app or create an account.

### Can I see one before I order?

Yes. Open the sample birthday page made for a fictional Aarya, or the sample wedding invitation. Both are linked from the plans.

### What does a branding project include?

A branding project usually covers the name if needed, the logo and its variations, colours, typefaces and a short guideline, delivered as ready-to-use files. Packaging and print are added when you need them.

### Can you refresh a brand that already exists?

Yes. We look at what you have, keep what works and redraw the rest, so customers still recognise you.

### How is branding priced?

By scope. We talk first, then send a written quote before any work begins.

### Do you design and build the website, or only design it?

Both. Project Arthouse plans, writes, designs and builds the site, then sets up the domain and hosting and launches it.

### Will I be able to update the site myself?

Yes. We build so that routine changes such as text, photos and prices are easy, and we hand over a short guide.

### How much does a website cost?

It depends on the number of pages and what the site has to do, so we discuss it first. Share your idea and we send a written quote before any work begins.

### Which platforms do you manage?

Facebook, Instagram and YouTube. We plan the content, design the posts and videos, and publish them for you.

### Do you design the posts and videos as well?

Yes. Post design and video design are part of the service, in the same look as the rest of your brand.

### How is social media management priced?

By the number of platforms and how much goes out each month. We discuss it first and send a written quote before any work begins.
